  | .box, .s0 l r => tree3Valid .box l && tree3Valid .box r
  | .tri12, .s0 l r => tree3Valid .tri12 l && tree3Valid .tri12 r
  | .box, .s1 l r => tree3Valid .box l && tree3Valid .box r
  | .box, .s2 l r => tree3Valid .box l && tree3Valid .box r
  | .tri01, .s2 l r => tree3Valid .tri01 l && tree3Valid .tri01 r
  | .tri01, .sd01 c0 m c1 => tree3Valid .tri01 c0 && tree3Valid .box m && tree3Valid .tri01 c1
  | .tri12, .sd12 c0 m c1 => tree3Valid .tri12 c0 && tree3Valid .box m && tree3Valid .tri12 c1
  | .simp, .sd012 c0 m01 m12 c1 =>
      tree3Valid .simp c0 && tree3Valid .tri01 m01 && tree3Valid .tri12 m12 && tree3Valid .simp c1
  | _, _ => false

      f a0 a1 a2 + f a0 a1 b2 + f a0 b1 a2 + f a0 b1 b2 +
      f b0 a1 a2 + f b0 a1 b2 + f b0 b1 a2 + f b0 b1 b2
  | .tri01, a0, b0, _, _, a2, b2 =>
      f a0 a0 a2 + f a0 a0 b2 + f a0 b0 a2 + f a0 b0 b2 + f b0 b0 a2 + f b0 b0 b2
  | .tri12, a0, b0, a1, b1, _, _ =>
      f a0 a1 a1 + f b0 a1 a1 + f a0 a1 b1 + f b0 a1 b1 + f a0 b1 b1 + f b0 b1 b1
  | .simp, a0, b0, _, _, _, _ =>
      f a0 a0 a0 + f a0 a0 b0 + f a0 b0 b0 + f b0 b0 b0

name: evalTree4
statement:
def evalTree4 (lfFn : CellKind → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat) :
    CellKind → BoxTree4 → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | knd, .lf, a0, b0, a1, b1, a2, b2, a3, b3 => lfFn knd a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 b2 a3 b3
  | knd, .s0 l r, a0, b0, a1, b1, a2, b2, a3, b3 =>
      let m := (a0 + b0) / 2
      evalTree4 lfFn knd l a0 m a1 b1 a2 b2 a3 b3 + evalTree4 lfFn knd r m b0 a1 b1 a2 b2 a3 b3
  | knd, .s1 l r, a0, b0, a1, b1, a2, b2, a3, b3 =>
      let m := (a1 + b1) / 2
      evalTree4 lfFn knd l a0 b0 a1 m a2 b2 a3 b3 + evalTree4 lfFn knd r a0 b0 m b1 a2 b2 a3 b3
  | knd, .s2 l r, a0, b0, a1, b1, a2, b2, a3, b3 =>
      let m := (a2 + b2) / 2
      evalTree4 lfFn knd l a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 m a3 b3 + evalTree4 lfFn knd r a0 b0 a1 b1 m b2 a3 b3
  | knd, .s3 l r, a0, b0, a1, b1, a2, b2, a3, b3 =>
      let m := (a3 + b3) / 2
      evalTree4 lfFn knd l a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 b2 a3 m + evalTree4 lfFn knd r a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 b2 m b3
  | _, .sd01 c0 md c1, a, b, _, _, a2, b2, a3, b3 =>
      let m := (a + b) / 2
      evalTree4 lfFn .tri01 c0 a m a m a2 b2 a3 b3 +
      evalTree4 lfFn .box md a m m b a2 b2 a3 b3 +
      evalTree4 lfFn .tri01 c1 m b m b a2 b2 a3 b3
  | _, .sd12 c0 md c1, a0, b0, a, b, _, _, a3, b3 =>
      let m := (a + b) / 2
      evalTree4 lfFn .tri12 c0 a0 b0 a m a m a3 b3 +
      evalTree4 lfFn .box md a0 b0 a m m b a3 b3 +
      evalTree4 lfFn .tri12 c1 a0 b0 m b m b a3 b3
  | _, .sd012 c0 m01 m12 c1, a, b, _, _, _, _, a3, b3 =>
      let m := (a + b) / 2
      evalTree4 lfFn .simp c0 a m a m a m a3 b3 +
      evalTree4 lfFn .tri01 m01 a m a m m b a3 b3 +
      evalTree4 lfFn .tri12 m12 a m m b m b a3 b3 +
      evalTree4 lfFn .simp c1 m b m b m b a3 b3
plain: Evaluate the supplied natural leaf function along the four dimensional tree using the stated subdivision rules.

name: evalTree3
statement:
def evalTree3 (lfFn : CellKind → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat × Nat) :
    CellKind → BoxTree3 → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat × Nat
  | knd, .lf, a0, b0, a1, b1, a2, b2 => lfFn knd a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 b2
  | knd, .s0 l r, a0, b0, a1, b1, a2, b2 =>
      let m := (a0 + b0) / 2
      addPair (evalTree3 lfFn knd l a0 m a1 b1 a2 b2) (evalTree3 lfFn knd r m b0 a1 b1 a2 b2)
  | knd, .s1 l r, a0, b0, a1, b1, a2, b2 =>
      let m := (a1 + b1) / 2
      addPair (evalTree3 lfFn knd l a0 b0 a1 m a2 b2) (evalTree3 lfFn knd r a0 b0 m b1 a2 b2)
  | knd, .s2 l r, a0, b0, a1, b1, a2, b2 =>
      let m := (a2 + b2) / 2
      addPair (evalTree3 lfFn knd l a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 m) (evalTree3 lfFn knd r a0 b0 a1 b1 m b2)
  | _, .sd01 c0 md c1, a, b, _, _, a2, b2 =>
      let m := (a + b) / 2
      addPair (addPair (evalTree3 lfFn .tri01 c0 a m a m a2 b2)
                       (evalTree3 lfFn .box md a m m b a2 b2))
              (evalTree3 lfFn .tri01 c1 m b m b a2 b2)
  | _, .sd12 c0 md c1, a0, b0, a, b, _, _ =>
      let m := (a + b) / 2
      addPair (addPair (evalTree3 lfFn .tri12 c0 a0 b0 a m a m)
                       (evalTree3 lfFn .box md a0 b0 a m m b))
              (evalTree3 lfFn .tri12 c1 a0 b0 m b m b)
  | _, .sd012 c0 m01 m12 c1, a, b, _, _, _, _ =>
      let m := (a + b) / 2
      addPair (addPair (evalTree3 lfFn .simp c0 a m a m a m)
                       (evalTree3 lfFn .tri01 m01 a m a m m b))
              (addPair (evalTree3 lfFn .tri12 m12 a m m b m b)
                       (evalTree3 lfFn .simp c1 m b m b m b))

    (∀ i, ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 ≤ b → a + b = 1 →

    | .tri01 => ∫ x2 in a2..b2, ∫ x1 in a0..b0, ∫ x0 in a0..x1, f ![x0, x1, x2]

    | .simp => ∫ x2 in a0..b0, ∫ x1 in a0..x2, ∫ x0 in a0..x1, f ![x0, x1, x2]) ∧
(∀ (knd : CellKind) {a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 b2 : ℝ}, cell3Ok knd a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 b2 →
  ∀ {f : (Fin 3 → ℝ) → ℝ}, ConvexOn ℝ (cell3Set knd a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 b2) f →

  ContinuousOn f (cell3Set knd a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 b2) →
  ((b0 - a0) * (b1 - a1) * (b2 - a2) / (facDen knd : ℝ)) *
      f (centroid3R knd a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 b2) ≤
    ∫ x in cell3Set knd a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 b2, f x) ∧
(∀ (knd : CellKind) {a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 b2 a3 b3 : ℝ},
  cell3Ok knd a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 b2 → a3 ≤ b3 →
  ∀ {f : (Fin 4 → ℝ) → ℝ}, ConvexOn ℝ (cell4Set knd a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 b2 a3 b3) f →

  ∫ x in cell3Set .box a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 b2, max 0 (L - (x 0 + x 1 + 2 * x 2)) =

name: cell3_Mm_pos_interior
statement:
private lemma cell3_Mm_pos_interior {pa_n pb_n : ℕ}
    {knd : CellKind} {n0a n0b n1a n1b n2a n2b : ℕ}
    (hv : cell3Valid knd n0a n0b n1a n1b n2a n2b)
    (h1 : ¬ pb_n * D_x ≤ D_p * (n0a + n1a + 2 * n2a) + B_sc)
    (h2 : D_p * (n0b + n1b + 2 * n2b) + C_sc ≤ pa_n * D_x) :
    let pa : ℝ := (pa_n : ℝ) / D_p
    let pa_sc := pa_n * D_x
    let f3 (a0 a1 a2 : Nat) : Nat :=
      let rb := pa_sc - D_p * (a0 + a1 + a2 + B_n)
      let rc := pa_sc - D_p * (a0 + a1 + a2 + C_n)
      ceilDiv (S_v * D_x6 * D_p2) (a0 * a1 * a2 * B_n * rb * rb) +
      ceilDiv (S_v * D_x6 * D_p2) (a0 * a1 * a2 * C_n * rc * rc)
    ∫ y in cell3Set knd ((n0a : ℝ) / D_x) ((n0b : ℝ) / D_x) ((n1a : ℝ) / D_x) ((n1b : ℝ) / D_x) ((n2a : ℝ) / D_x) ((n2b : ℝ) / D_x),
      ((C_R - B_R) / 2) *
        (1 / (y 0 * y 1 * y 2 * B_R * (pa - (y 0 + y 1 + y 2) - B_R) ^ 2) +
         1 / (y 0 * y 1 * y 2 * C_R * (pa - (y 0 + y 1 + y 2) - C_R) ^ 2)) ≤
      (ceilDiv (S_3 * (n0b - n0a) * (n1b - n1a) * (n2b - n2a) * (C_n - B_n) * sumVerts3 f3 knd n0a n0b n1a n1b n2a n2b)
        (2 * facDen knd * nVerts3 knd * D_x4 * S_v) : ℝ) / S_3
plain: In the full support interior branch, the increasing interval loss integral is bounded above by the scaled vertex upper quadrature.

name: cell3_Mm_pos_slab
statement:
private lemma cell3_Mm_pos_slab {pa_n pb_n : ℕ}
    {knd : CellKind} {n0a n0b n1a n1b n2a n2b : ℕ}
    (hv : cell3Valid knd n0a n0b n1a n1b n2a n2b)
    (h1 : ¬ pb_n * D_x ≤ D_p * (n0a + n1a + 2 * n2a) + B_sc) :
    let pb : ℝ := (pb_n : ℝ) / D_p
    let s_min_n := D_p * (n0a + n1a + 2 * n2a)
    let pb_sc := pb_n * D_x
    let rn := ramp3Num (n0b - n0a) (n1b - n1a) (n2b - n2a) (pb_sc - B_sc - s_min_n) -
              ramp3Num (n0b - n0a) (n1b - n1a) (n2b - n2a) (pb_sc - C_sc - s_min_n)
    ∫ y in cell3Set knd ((n0a : ℝ) / D_x) ((n0b : ℝ) / D_x) ((n1a : ℝ) / D_x) ((n1b : ℝ) / D_x) ((n2a : ℝ) / D_x) ((n2b : ℝ) / D_x),
      (max 0 (pb - B_R - (y 0 + y 1 + 2 * y 2)) - max 0 (pb - C_R - (y 0 + y 1 + 2 * y 2))) /
        (((n0a : ℝ) / D_x) * ((n1a : ℝ) / D_x) * ((n2a : ℝ) / D_x) ^ 3 * B_R) ≤
      (ceilDiv (S_3 * D_x2 * rn) (48 * facDen knd * D_p4 * n0a * n1a * n2a * n2a * n2a * B_n) : ℝ) / S_3
plain: In the partial support branch, the increasing interval loss integral is bounded above by the exact truncated affine ramp moment and the minimum reciprocal denominator.

    pa_n ≤ pb_n → (pb_n : ℝ) / p.D_p ≤ 5 * p.A_R + p.B_R →

    (let r := evalTree3 (evalMmLeaf p pa_n pb_n) .simp t p.A_n p.B_n p.A_n p.B_n p.A_n p.B_n; r.1 ≤ r.2) →
    ∀ {φ : ℝ}, (pa_n : ℝ) / p.D_p ≤ φ → φ ≤ (pb_n : ℝ) / p.D_p →
    I_fn p ω φ ≤ I_fn p ω ((pb_n : ℝ) / p.D_p)) ∧
  (∀ {pa_n pb_n : ℕ} {t : BoxTree3},
    pa_n ≤ pb_n → (pb_n : ℝ) / p.D_p ≤ 5 * p.A_R + p.B_R →
    tree3Valid .simp t = true →
    (let r := evalTree3 (evalMpLeaf p pa_n pb_n) .simp t p.A_n p.B_n p.A_n p.B_n p.A_n p.B_n; r.1 ≤ r.2) →
    ∀ {φ : ℝ}, (pa_n : ℝ) / p.D_p ≤ φ → φ ≤ (pb_n : ℝ) / p.D_p →
    I_fn p ω φ ≤ I_fn p ω ((pa_n : ℝ) / p.D_p)) ∧
  (∀ {bnd_n pa_n ps_n : ℕ} {t3 : BoxTree3} {t4 : BoxTree4},
    pa_n ≤ ps_n → (ps_n : ℝ) / p.D_p ≤ 5 * p.A_R + p.B_R →
    tree3Valid .simp t3 = true → tree4Valid .simp t4 = true →
    (let r := evalTree3 (evalMmLeaf p pa_n ps_n) .simp t3 p.A_n p.B_n p.A_n p.B_n p.A_n p.B_n
     let v := evalTree4 (eval4Leaf p ps_n) .simp t4 p.A_n p.B_n p.A_n p.B_n p.A_n p.B_n p.B_n p.C_n
     v * p.D_p + (r.1 - r.2) * (ps_n - pa_n) * 100 ≤ bnd_n * p.D_p) →
    ∀ {φ : ℝ}, (pa_n : ℝ) / p.D_p ≤ φ → φ ≤ (ps_n : ℝ) / p.D_p →
    I_fn p ω φ ≤ (bnd_n : ℝ) / p.S_4) ∧
  (∀ {bnd_n ps_n pb_n : ℕ} {t3 : BoxTree3} {t4 : BoxTree4},
    ps_n ≤ pb_n → (pb_n : ℝ) / p.D_p ≤ 5 * p.A_R + p.B_R →
    tree3Valid .simp t3 = true → tree4Valid .simp t4 = true →
    (let r := evalTree3 (evalMpLeaf p ps_n pb_n) .simp t3 p.A_n p.B_n p.A_n p.B_n p.A_n p.B_n
     let v := evalTree4 (eval4Leaf p ps_n) .simp t4 p.A_n p.B_n p.A_n p.B_n p.A_n p.B_n p.B_n p.C_n
     v * p.D_p + (r.1 - r.2) * (pb_n - ps_n) * 100 ≤ bnd_n * p.D_p) →
    ∀ {φ : ℝ}, (ps_n : ℝ) / p.D_p ≤ φ → φ ≤ (pb_n : ℝ) / p.D_p →
    I_fn p ω φ ≤ (bnd_n : ℝ) / p.S_4) ∧
  (∀ {bnd_n pa_n : ℕ} {t4 : BoxTree4},
    p.D_p * (4 * p.B_n + p.C_n) ≤ pa_n * p.D_x →
    tree4Valid .simp t4 = true →
    evalTree4 (eval4TransLeaf p pa_n) .simp t4 p.A_n p.B_n p.A_n p.B_n p.A_n p.B_n p.B_n p.C_n ≤ bnd_n →
    ∀ {φ : ℝ}, (pa_n : ℝ) / p.D_p ≤ φ →
    I_fn p ω φ ≤ (bnd_n : ℝ) / p.S_4)
